key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9686
name: or_angle_tile_into_planes
description: Scales a value to a 360-step circle, splits it into 45-step buckets and picks a tile offset from the bucket and remainder. It then ORs table words from that tile into 16-row column blocks of a bitplane buffer, computing the second block's offsets the same way.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:96BA
name: or_column_while_countdown_positive
description: While a countdown is above zero it decrements the countdown and ORs one word into a long column of rows in the bitplane buffer. It then ORs successive table words into further rows at fixed row offsets.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:96F0
name: or_column_countdown_with_calls
description: Runs the same countdown-gated column OR as its neighbours, with a longer body that also calls six other routines the code leaves unnamed.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9798
name: or_column_countdown_shared_entry
description: Countdown-gated column OR that seven unnamed routines call into. It decrements the countdown, ORs a shared word down a column of the bitplane buffer and then merges table words into the following rows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9834
name: branch_then_or_countdown_column
description: Tests two signed state values and branches around a block of calls depending on their signs, then falls into the countdown-gated column OR shared with its neighbours.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9862
name: or_column_after_sign_branch
description: Branches on the sign of a state value, then runs the countdown-gated column OR, with nine unnamed calls in its body.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:999E
name: load_scaled_coordinates_then_or
description: Loads two coordinate values from a state record, scaling them by 32 or shifting one right by 4 depending on sign tests, then runs the countdown-gated column OR.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:99F0
name: scale_coordinates_then_or_column
description: Scales coordinate values by 32 and shifts a third value right by 4 under a sign test, then runs the countdown-gated column OR. It also makes seven unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9B3E
name: or_column_countdown_fixed_rows
description: Countdown-gated column OR with a fixed set of row offsets. It decrements the countdown and merges one word into a column of rows in the bitplane buffer, then merges table words into the rows that follow.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9B6E
name: or_column_countdown_fallthrough_body
description: Body of the countdown-gated column OR, which merges table words into bitplane rows. The disassembly lists only one instruction here, so this entry is probably reached by falling through from a neighbouring routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9B72
name: or_column_countdown_shared_tail
description: Countdown-gated column OR shared by three unnamed routines. It decrements the countdown, ORs one word down a column of the bitplane buffer and merges table words into the rows after it. The disassembly lists a single instruction, so its entry is probably a fall-through target.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9B76
name: or_column_countdown_five_calls
description: Countdown-gated column OR that merges one word into a column of bitplane rows and table words into the rows after them. Its body also contains five unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9BB2
name: setup_blitter_then_or_column
description: Waits until the blitter is idle by polling the DMA control status, sets its destination modulo to 24 bytes and programs its source and destination pointers. It then runs the countdown-gated column OR, with six unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9C60
name: or_column_countdown_variant_two
description: Countdown-gated column OR with the same structure as its neighbours. It decrements the countdown, merges one word into a column of bitplane rows and then merges table words into the following rows, with five unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9C9C
name: branch_flag_then_or_column
description: Reads a flag through a pointer and branches on it, then runs the countdown-gated column OR. The body makes seven unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9D52
name: or_column_countdown_six_calls
description: Countdown-gated column OR that merges one word into a column of bitplane rows and table words into the rows after them. Its body makes six unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9D9C
name: copy_record_after_countdown
description: Decrements a countdown and, when it reaches zero, sets a state byte to 255 and resets the countdown. Other paths scale a value and copy a null-terminated byte record from a table into a fixed destination, and the routine references the title text F15 Strike Eagle.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9DF2
name: select_table_record_and_copy
description: Calls an unnamed routine for an index, scales it by 50 and reads a 16-bit entry from a fixed table. A zero entry sets a not-found state, otherwise a state byte is set and a null-terminated record is copied into a fixed destination, before the countdown-gated column OR runs.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9E3A
name: search_records_then_copy
description: Searches up to ten records, each 86 bytes apart, for one whose flag byte has bit 2 set. When it finds one it copies that record's null-terminated text into a fixed destination, otherwise it sets the state to not found.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9E42
name: scan_records_for_text_flag
description: Walks 86-byte records looking for a flag byte with bit 1 set, then copies the matching record's null-terminated text into a fixed destination and sets a state value of 32. The routine references the text on patrol.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9EB4
name: reset_state_or_angle_tile
description: Clears a state byte and sets another to 255, then runs the 45-step angle-to-tile column OR shared with the first routine. Its register references include the DMA control register.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:9F5A
name: or_column_after_flag_checks
description: Branches on several state flags and then runs the countdown-gated column OR, with nine unnamed calls in its body.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A04E
name: set_flag_then_or_column
description: Sets a flag word from a constant and clears it when a state value is non-zero, then runs the countdown-gated column OR. The body also makes five unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A100
name: set_flag_or_many_calls
description: Same flag setup and countdown-gated column OR as its neighbour, with eleven unnamed calls in its body.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A1E0
name: copy_state_then_or_column
description: Copies one state value into another, tests whether two further state values differ, and then runs the countdown-gated column OR. The disassembly lists a single instruction, so this entry is probably a fall-through target.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A1E4
name: copy_check_then_or_column
description: Copies a state value, tests whether two other state values differ and runs the countdown-gated column OR. Its body makes seven unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A2B6
name: position_sprite_number_display
description: Checks whether a value is outside 0 to 1000, then splits it by hundreds and tens into offsets along a sprite strip in 8-byte steps, rounding up past fixed thresholds. It writes the resulting sprite pointers and control words into the display and clears the spare slots.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A3A2
name: position_sprite_digit_pair
description: Splits an input value by ten, placing the tens and ones digits along a sprite strip in 8-byte steps and adding a 4-byte half-step when the remainder exceeds four. It stores the resulting sprite pointers in the state record and clears a sprite slot.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A46C
name: clear_sprite_pointer_slot
description: Writes zero through a pointer held in the state record and returns. It is only a few instructions and clears a single sprite pointer slot.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A47C
name: copy_pointer_when_flag_set
description: When a flag in the state is non-zero, copies a stored pointer from one state record slot into another slot, then returns.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A492
name: store_low_word_global
description: Stores the incoming 16-bit argument into a global variable and returns. It is a plain setter with no other logic.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A4CA
name: load_state_field_into_global
description: Loads a 32-bit field from a state record into a global variable and returns. The routine only copies the value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A50C
name: load_second_state_field_global
description: Loads a different 32-bit field from the state record into a global variable and returns. It only copies the value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A54E
name: position_sprite_digits_alt
description: Positions sprite digits from a value as in its neighbour, with a different idle-flag branch that writes a zero pointer or the stored pointer into the state record when a second flag is set. It returns after updating the sprite pointers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A55A
name: load_sprite_state_field
description: Copies a 32-bit field from a state record into a global variable and returns. It is called by nine unnamed routines, and its facts list sprite pointer registers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A58C
name: load_alt_state_field_global
description: Copies a different 32-bit field from the state record into a global variable and returns. Its body only copies the value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A606
name: scan_active_record_slots
description: Walks a table of 86-byte records and tests flag bit 2 on up to eight slots, then computes a scaled offset from the first matching entry. It references the short text HCHDHE6 and is called by fifteen unnamed routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A870
name: tick_counter_then_dispatch
description: Decrements a counter and, while it stays non-zero, calls a handler through a pointer stored in the state record. At zero it reads flag words and copies table values into the custom chip register area and state fields.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A878
name: tick_counter_set_background_color
description: Uses the same counter-driven dispatch as its neighbour, but its facts show it also writes the background colour register.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A912
name: clamp_and_scale_coordinates
description: Checks whether position differences lie within plus or minus 16384 and returns through an unnamed call when they do not. Within range it computes scaled offsets from table entries, shifting them right by two.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:A94A
name: test_range_and_set_flag
description: Tests several state values against range and ordering conditions, calling unnamed routines for two of them. When the conditions pass it sets a flag word to 255, and otherwise it branches out.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:AB20
name: copy_state_into_record_table
description: Tests two flag bits in a record, clears a flag byte and copies current state fields into consecutive four-word table entries. It makes two unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:AC72
name: update_control_state_and_status
description: Large routine that updates several control state values from inputs, scaling and clamping them, and refers to the status text brakes on, landing gear raised. It calls seventeen unnamed routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:BDCE
name: update_state_when_changed
description: Returns early when two linked pointers match. Otherwise it reads a 2-bit mode field, resets a 16-bit state to 127 when the mode changes and adjusts bit-field values, calling three unnamed routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:BEBE
name: interpolate_wrapped_table_value
description: Compares a 16-bit value with a stored reference and, when the difference exceeds 8192, wraps the value by 32768. It then linearly interpolates a result from a table indexed by the value's upper bits.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:BEC2
name: interpolate_table_with_calls
description: Performs the same wrapped table interpolation as its neighbour, with a longer body that also makes two unnamed calls and stores the result in a shared location.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1B0
name: interpolate_angle_table_product_a
description: Interpolates two values from a 32-step table indexed by an angle, using the low five bits as the fraction. It multiplies the results into a fixed-point product stored in a shared location and makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1B8
name: interpolate_angle_table_product_b
description: Repeats the angle-table interpolation and fixed-point product of its neighbour with a shorter body. It makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1CC
name: interpolate_angle_table_pair_c
description: Interpolates table values for the angle with the same fraction handling as its neighbours and multiplies them into a fixed-point product. Three unnamed routines call it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1E0
name: interpolate_angle_table_entry_d
description: Angle-table interpolation and fixed-point product, the same as its neighbours. The disassembly lists a single instruction, so its entry is probably a fall-through target.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1E8
name: interpolate_angle_table_entry_e
description: Angle-table interpolation with a fixed-point product, as in its neighbours. It makes no unnamed calls and is called by five routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1EC
name: interpolate_angle_table_entry_f
description: Angle-table interpolation and fixed-point product, the same as the other entries in this family. It makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C1F0
name: interpolate_angle_table_full
description: Long version of the angle-table interpolation and product, with about two hundred instructions. It stores a 255 constant through a helper call and makes three further unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C3CE
name: combine_rotated_product_sums
description: Forms sums of products of interpolated table values and stores the rounded results into shared locations, adding one to a result when it is negative. It makes four unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C512
name: combine_rotated_product_sums_b
description: Forms the same kind of rounded product sums from interpolated table values and stores them in shared locations. It makes four unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C656
name: combine_rotated_product_sums_c
description: Forms rounded product sums from interpolated table values, storing them in shared locations and adding one to negative results. It makes six unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C79A
name: divide_by_shift_subtract
description: Performs a seven-step shift and subtract division on a 32-bit value, negating negative operands first. It returns the quotient to the caller.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C7C4
name: normalize_signed_fixed_point
description: Handles a zero divisor by returning the high word, special-cases the most negative 16-bit value and negates negative operands. It then runs a normalization loop and calls one unnamed routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C820
name: complement_call_result_from_constant
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns 16384 minus its result, taking the complement against a quarter-turn constant.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C82C
name: search_table_segment_index
description: Takes the absolute value of its argument and finds its segment in a table indexed by the value shifted right seven. It steps forward while the table entry does not exceed the argument and returns the negated step count shifted left five.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:C862
name: update_landing_status_flags
description: Updates state fields from a set of conditions, clearing a counter when they hold and comparing offsets against thresholds. It refers to the status phrases ready for takeoff, safe landing and weapons replenished and makes seven unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:D0CE
name: or_angle_tile_status_bits
description: Sets bits in a status word, then runs the 45-step angle-to-tile column OR shared with the first routine. Its body makes seven unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:D0F2
name: update_weapon_status_display
description: Large display routine of about 570 instructions. It waits for the blitter when a flag is set, programs its pointers and copies display data into place, and selects status text such as missile lock, primary, no target and secondary. It makes seventeen unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:D82A
name: wait_blitter_then_program_copy
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then programs its destination pointer, size and modulo registers before returning. It makes four unnamed calls elsewhere in its body.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:DA0E
name: advance_phase_blit_on_wrap
description: Sets a bit in a memory location indexed by its argument, then advances a 16-bit phase accumulator by half its range. When the accumulator wraps it waits for the blitter and programs its pointers and modulo, then returns the argument with a constant bit set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:DA2C
name: draw_display_with_phase_blit
description: Large routine of about 330 instructions that advances the same phase accumulator and waits for the blitter when it wraps. It computes table-based values, reads the DMA control status and makes sixteen unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:DEF2
name: copy_region_if_within_bounds
description: Returns unless both inputs fall inside a window of roughly 120 to 175. Inside the window it computes a plane buffer address and copies six rows of data from a source pointer, with one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:DFB0
name: compute_scaled_offset_difference
description: Computes the scaled difference between two coordinate offsets measured from fixed reference values, shifting them by a count taken from a state field, and adds 146 to the result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E00C
name: wait_blitter_then_program_b
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, programs its destination pointer, size and modulo registers and returns the low byte of its argument. Three unnamed routines call it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E068
name: wait_blitter_then_set_size
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then sets its destination pointer and size registers and returns. It makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E0A6
name: select_octant_table_entry
description: Takes the absolute horizontal and vertical distances between two coordinate pairs and derives an octant index from their signs and ordering. It reads a table entry for that octant and computes a plane offset from the first pair.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E0AA
name: select_octant_step_entry
description: Derives an octant index from the signs and order of two coordinate distances and reads the matching table entry, with a plane offset computed from the first coordinate pair.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E0AE
name: select_octant_offset_entry
description: Uses the same octant selection from coordinate distances as its neighbours, reading the table entry that matches the octant and computing a plane offset from the first pair.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E0B2
name: select_octant_byte_and_step
description: Computes an octant index from coordinate distances and reads a byte from a table at that index, then steps the distance by one. It also computes a plane offset from the first coordinate pair.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E0BC
name: select_octant_entry_with_call
description: Derives an octant index from the signs and order of two coordinate distances, reads the matching table entry and makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E16A
name: walk_flagged_records_with_calls
description: Waits on a hardware status bit, then walks up to eight 86-byte records, testing a flag bit and calling an unnamed routine for each matching record. It makes four unnamed calls in total.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E21E
name: wait_blitter_then_program_source
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, sets its destination pointer from a state field and programs its size register before returning. It makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E276
name: wait_blitter_program_and_draw
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, programs its destination pointer from a state field and clears its modulo, then runs about a hundred instructions with six unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E3CE
name: project_center_offset_to_plane
description: Scales two coordinate differences from reference values, adds fixed centring offsets of 79 and 154, and looks up a 160-byte record to compute a plane address. It returns early when a flag is non-zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E3D2
name: project_centre_to_plane_b
description: Applies the same centring offsets and record lookup as its neighbour to compute a plane address from two scaled coordinate differences, returning early when a flag is set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E3D6
name: project_centre_to_plane_c
description: Computes a plane address from scaled coordinate differences with the centring offsets of 79 and 154, as in its neighbours. Two unnamed routines call it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E3DA
name: project_center_offset_and_draw
description: Repeats the centred coordinate projection of its neighbours in a shorter body, with three unnamed calls. It references the text 2 4 6 8 T x.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E432
name: copy_state_snapshot_and_update
description: Large routine of about 300 instructions that copies table words into a state snapshot and updates several derived values from them. It makes seven unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E852
name: clear_linked_entries_until_end
description: Looks up a record from a 128-entry table and returns early when its fields are set. Otherwise it walks following entries and zeroes a pointer for each entry whose field is negative, with seven unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E9BE
name: find_record_without_flags
description: Stores a shifted coordinate value and scans a table of 50-byte records for the first one whose flag bits are clear, counting down through the table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E9C2
name: find_record_without_flags_b
description: Repeats the record scan of its neighbour, storing the shifted coordinate value and stepping through 50-byte records until one has its flag bits clear.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:E9DE
name: scan_records_without_flags_c
description: Scans 50-byte records for the first one whose flag bits are clear, after storing a shifted coordinate value. It makes four unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:EA26
name: wait_blitter_then_program_pair
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, programs its source and destination pointers from state offsets and sets its size register, then returns. It makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:EA7E
name: dispatch_handler_if_in_window
description: Projects two coordinate differences with the centring offsets and, when both fall inside the windows of 48 to 110 and 125 to 184, calls a handler selected from a table by an index.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:EB6E
name: and_mask_into_plane_words
description: ANDs a mask into one 16-bit word of a bitplane group and into the word 20 bytes further along.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:EB8E
name: or_or_and_plane_words
description: ORs one mask into a bitplane word and into the word 20 bytes further along, then ANDs another mask into the word 40 bytes along. The 40-byte step matches the row stride used by the column routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:EBAE
name: and_and_or_plane_words
description: ANDs a mask into a bitplane word and into the word 20 bytes further along, then ORs another mask into the word 40 bytes along.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:EBCE
name: or_and_or_plane_words
description: ORs a mask into a bitplane word, ANDs another into the word 20 bytes along and ORs a third into the word 40 bytes along.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:EBEE
name: or_words_into_plane_pair
description: ORs one mask into a bitplane word and into the word 20 bytes further along.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:EC0E
name: fill_masked_rows_with_limit
description: Large routine of about 860 instructions. It clamps a row count to 40 and fills bitplane rows by ORing a high-byte mask into alternate words, stepping back 80 bytes per row. It references the text 9999 and makes three unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:F822
name: copy_table_rows_into_plane
description: Copies table words into a bitplane buffer at an offset read from a lookup, writing a column of words with a row stride and ORing a second table's words into the same column. One unnamed routine calls it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:FAC2
name: wait_blitter_then_program_full
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, programs its source, destination and modulo registers along with its control and size values, then returns. It makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:FBDE
name: expand_nibbles_into_words
description: Expands a sequence of bytes into 16-bit words by splitting each byte into nibbles and writing them to three positions 160 and 320 bytes apart, over nine iterations. It makes three unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:FD8C
name: shift_plane_words_right_one
description: Shifts a pair of 16-bit words right by one bit, carrying the low bit of each word into the top bit of the next. This moves a bitplane row by one pixel.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:FDCC
name: expand_packed_nibbles_via_table
description: Loops over packed records until a zero word, using each nibble to look up a byte from a table indexed in steps of eight. It assembles the looked-up bits into a 16-bit word and writes it twice, with one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:FE3E
name: store_grey_palette_global
description: Stores a grey palette value into a global variable and returns. The facts list palette colour registers, but this body does not write them directly.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:FE88
name: or_angle_tile_large_variant
description: Large variant of the 45-step angle-to-tile column OR, about 950 instructions long, with five unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:10B62
name: clip_and_place_in_window
description: Computes a position from scaled deltas and checks it against window bounds of 20 to 92 and 88 to 232 before writing the result. It makes four unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:10DBA
name: or_two_words_into_plane
description: Loads two words from a source pointer and ORs them into many offsets of a target buffer. The disassembly lists a single instruction, so this entry is probably a fall-through target.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:10DBE
name: or_two_words_plane_b
description: Larger version of its neighbour, ORing the same two source words into many offsets of the target buffer in about 580 instructions.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:15300
name: link_matching_records
description: Walks linked records, testing flag bits and comparing record pointers to find entries whose flags are clear, then stores the matches. It makes eleven unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:155BC
name: init_record_from_source
description: Initialises an output record from a source record. Its first field is copied, the second is offset by 30 times an input value and a third is set to 12. When a flag bit is set it adjusts the fields by multiples of the input instead.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:155C0
name: init_record_from_source_b
description: Repeats the record initialisation of its neighbour, copying the source fields and offsetting them by a scaled input value. It makes two unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1567C
name: find_minimum_record_value
description: Scans 50-byte records whose flag bits are clear and keeps the record with the smallest value, copying its field into the output. It makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:156CA
name: wait_for_record_then_return
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine through a function pointer until a record's flag bits are clear and a table entry is non-zero, then returns.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:15784
name: poll_record_flags_until_ready
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine to select a 50-byte record and loops until its flag bits meet a condition. It then returns the record's high word combined with its flags.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1582C
name: insert_or_match_record_entry
description: Compares a new position against a table of 50-byte records and returns when an entry already matches. Otherwise it stores the position in the table and makes two unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1585C
name: insert_record_entry_if_new
description: Compares a position against a table of 50-byte records and returns if it is already present. If not, it stores the position and an accompanying value in the table, with two unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:30BB8
name: copy_record_table_from_state
description: Copies a table of 50-byte records from a state block into a global table field by field, along with a count and a 32-bit field.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:30C68
name: wait_os_reply_with_timeout
description: When two state values differ, calls operating-system library routines through the library base, including a wait with a timeout of 60000, then copies a status value into the state. It makes four unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:30D3A
name: copy_buffer_into_state_records
description: Calls an operating-system library routine, then copies the words and fields of the received buffer into state records in a loop of about eleven iterations.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:30EBC
name: set_global_flag_255
description: Stores 255 into a global variable and returns. It is a two-instruction stub.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:30F6C
name: store_inputs_and_walk_records
description: Large routine of about 430 instructions. It stores its register inputs into globals, computes table indices from a coordinate value and walks linked records. It references the text HCHDHE6 and makes fourteen unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:31C6C
name: project_point_through_matrix
description: Transforms an offset point by nine stored matrix coefficients, scaling the sums by 32. When the resulting depth term is positive it divides to project the point and stores the result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:31C70
name: project_point_through_matrix_b
description: Applies the same nine-coefficient matrix transform and projection as its neighbour to an offset point, storing the projected values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:31C74
name: project_point_through_matrix_c
description: Multiplies an offset point by the stored matrix coefficients and projects it when the depth term is positive, as in its neighbours.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:31C78
name: project_point_matrix_with_clear
description: Applies the matrix transform and projection to an offset point, clearing a result field along the way.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:31C7C
name: project_point_matrix_d
description: Repeats the matrix transform and projection of its neighbours on an offset point, storing the projected values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:31C84
name: project_point_matrix_on_axis
description: Applies the same matrix transform to an offset point with a shorter body, making three unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:31C9E
name: transform_point_through_matrix_direct
description: Multiplies raw inputs by the stored matrix coefficients and scales them by 32 without subtracting the reference offsets. It projects the result when it is positive and makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:31D18
name: draw_scaled_span_with_blitter
description: Computes a scaled value from a table entry by division with added offsets, then programs the blitter's data, size and destination registers. It makes four unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:31E4E
name: copy_list_entries_by_key
description: Large routine of about 930 instructions that copies entries from an input list into a global list, comparing key values against a table. It makes eight unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:32D8A
name: append_small_records_to_buffer
description: Appends short records to a buffer. For a zero delta it writes a type value of 6 and a value of 4, stores two coordinates and advances the buffer pointer. It makes two unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:32E48
name: populate_decrementing_sequence
description: Writes a sequence of 16-bit values into a buffer, subtracting a constant and an extended-precision carry from an accumulator at each step. It is about 440 instructions long and makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:331CE
name: populate_arithmetic_sequence
description: Writes an arithmetic sequence into a buffer, where each entry is the previous value plus a constant and an extended-precision carry, stored as successive words. It is about 400 instructions long.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:33500
name: merge_two_sorted_lists
description: Waits for the blitter and clears its control register, then walks two lists of 16-bit entries, comparing their leading words to choose which entry to copy forward. Called by 29 unnamed routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:33504
name: merge_sorted_lists_b
description: Merges two lists of 16-bit entries by comparing leading words and copying the smaller forward, after waiting for the blitter and clearing its control register. It makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:33600
name: combine_rows_with_nand_mask
description: Loops over 160-byte rows and combines two table masks with an inverted AND, writing the result into bitplane words. It makes two unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:33646
name: combine_rows_nand_mask_b
description: Repeats the row loop of its neighbour, combining two table masks with an inverted AND and writing into 160-byte row steps. It makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:336BC
name: merge_sorted_lists_c
description: Merges two lists of 16-bit entries by comparing leading words, after waiting for the blitter and clearing its control register. It makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr ep][a](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr EP][a](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:337B8
name: combine_rows_and_or_masks
description: Loops over 160-byte rows, combining two table masks with AND, OR and an inverted AND into bitplane words. It makes two unnamed calls.
